key_limitations: No documentation files exist in the source directory (only images)
Source is named 'Diseases Dataset' — purpose described as disease detection, not freshness classification
No operational definition of 'Healthy' or 'Rotten' found in any source
No documentation of label assignment method (human inspection, measurement protocol, automatic rules)
No sample-level provenance or collection conditions documented
Five Carrot records have conflicting Healthy/Rotten labels on identical byte content
Four produce types (Grape, Guava, Jujube, Pomegranate) have no corresponding class in the Fresh/Rotten model
Public Kaggle source page did not return readable documentation
conclusion: Label semantics are UNVERIFIED for all classes. Directory names 'Healthy' and 'Rotten' alone do not constitute credible documentation of freshness ground truth. No class mapping can be endorsed for independent evaluation until authoritative label documentation is obtained.
